description: This file contains unit tests for streaming behavior involving stateless worker grains within an Orleans-based application. It includes a test class 'StatelessWorkersStreamTests' that verifies subscription restrictions, a fixture class for setting up the test cluster, and a test runner class 'StatelessWorkersStreamTestsRunner' executing producer and consumer stream tests.

classes.name: StatelessWorkersStreamTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for stream subscription behavior with stateless worker grains, verifying proper subscription restrictions and setup.

classes.name: StatelessWorkersStreamTestsRunner
classes.description: A helper class to facilitate testing of stream producer and consumer behaviors involving stateless worker grains.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with memory stream provider and grain storage.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Configures a grain to become a stream consumer for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: ProduceMessage
methods.description: Instructs a grain to produce a message onto a specific stream.
